cues.en: So to see how I went about filtering outliers in the MovieLens data set, open up the MovieLens3.py file in the Challenges folder of your course materials.
cues.zh: 要看我如何在 MovieLens 資料集中濾除離群值，請開啟課程教材 Challenges 資料夾中的 MovieLens3.py。

cues.en: The changes are in the loadMovieLensSmall function.
cues.zh: 修改在 loadMovieLensSmall 函式裡。

cues.en: You can see I've re-implemented it such that it uses Pandas to load up the raw ratings data, and then I used Pandas to filter out those outliers.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我重新實作它，改用 Pandas 載入原始評分資料，再用 Pandas 濾除離群值。

cues.en: The resulting dataset for our recommender framework is then built up from the resulting Pandas dataframe instead of directly from the CSV ratings file.
cues.zh: 推薦框架所需的資料集，改從處理後的 Pandas DataFrame 建構，而非直接從 CSV 評分檔案建立。

cues.en: We start by loading up the ratings data into Pandas into a dataframe called ratings.
cues.zh: 首先，把評分資料載入 Pandas，存成名為 ratings 的 DataFrame。

cues.en: We print out the start of it and the shape so we can see what the data we're starting with looks like and how much of it there is.
cues.zh: 列印開頭與形狀，讓我們看到初始資料長什麼樣子，以及資料量多少。

cues.en: Next we need to identify any outlier users, which first means counting up how many ratings each user has.
cues.zh: 接著要找出離群的使用者，首先得計算每位使用者有多少筆評分。

cues.en: We use the groupby command on line 34 together with the aggregate command to build up a new dataframe called ratingsByUser that maps user IDs to their rating counts,
cues.zh: 第 34 行使用 groupby 搭配 aggregate 命令，建構新的 ratingsByUser DataFrame，將使用者 ID 對應到評分數量，

cues.en: and we print it out so we can see what we're working with as we develop and debug all of this.
cues.zh: 再列印出來，讓我們在開發與除錯時，能看到正在處理的內容。

cues.en: Now we're going to add a column to that ratingsByUser dataframe that indicates whether or not this user is considered an outlier.
cues.zh: 現在要在 ratingsByUser DataFrame 新增一欄，標示這位使用者是否被視為離群值。

cues.en: Pandas is pretty neat in that we can just define a new column by assigning it to a set of operations on the existing dataframe.
cues.zh: Pandas 很方便，只要把既有 DataFrame 的一組運算結果指派給新欄，就能定義它。

cues.en: Here we're taking the absolute value of the difference between each user's rating count and the mean rating count across all users, and comparing that to the standard deviation
cues.zh: 這裡取每位使用者評分數量，與所有使用者平均評分數量之差的絕對值，然後與評分數量的標準差，

cues.en: of the rating counts multiplied by the value we choose, which is three by default.
cues.zh: 乘上所選的值比較，預設值是三。

cues.en: So this line adds a new outlier column that is true if the rating count for this user is more than three standard deviations from the mean, or false otherwise.
cues.zh: 所以這一行新增 outlier 欄：如果這位使用者的評分數量與平均值相差超過三個標準差，就是 True，否則為 False。

cues.en: We don't need the actual rating column any longer, so we drop that and print out what we have at this stage.
cues.zh: 不再需要實際的 rating 欄，所以移除它，再列印這階段的結果。

cues.en: Next we merge this dataframe that indicates who are outliers and who aren't with our original ratings dataframe based on the user IDs.
cues.zh: 接著根據使用者 ID，把這個標示誰是離群值的 DataFrame，與原始 ratings DataFrame 合併。

cues.en: This gives us a handy outlier column on the raw individual ratings data.
cues.zh: 這樣原始的個別評分資料，就有方便使用的 outlier 欄。

cues.en: Again, we print out what we have so far on line 45.
cues.zh: 同樣地，在第 45 行列印目前的結果。

cues.en: Next we'll get rid of all the outlier data on line 47 by creating a new dataframe called filtered that is just the merged dataframe, but only including rows where the outlier column is false.
cues.zh: 接著在第 47 行移除所有離群資料，建立名為 filtered 的新 DataFrame，內容是合併後的 DataFrame，但只保留 outlier 欄為 False 的列。

cues.en: We can then drop the outlier and timestamp columns from the resulting dataframe as we don't need that data anymore.
cues.zh: 再從結果移除 outlier 和 timestamp 欄，因為不再需要這些資料。

cues.en: At this point we have what we want, a dataframe of individual user IDs, movie IDs, and ratings that excludes ratings from users that we consider an outlier.
cues.zh: 這時就得到了想要的內容：包含各筆使用者 ID、電影 ID 與評分的 DataFrame，並排除被視為離群使用者的評分。

cues.en: On lines 49 through 51, we print out the resulting dataframe and its shape so we can get a sense of how many ratings got dropped as a result of all this.
cues.zh: 第 49 到 51 行，列印產生的 DataFrame 與形狀，了解這一連串處理移除了多少評分。

cues.en: From there, we're fortunate that surpriselib has a convenience function for creating a dataset from a Pandas dataframe, which is what we're doing on line 54.
cues.zh: 接著很幸運，SurpriseLib 有方便的函式，可以從 Pandas DataFrame 建立資料集，這就是第 54 行的工作。

cues.en: So let's open up EvaluateUserCF-Outliers.py,
cues.zh: 開啟 EvaluateUserCF-Outliers.py，

cues.en: and kick it off to see what happens.
cues.zh: 執行看看會發生什麼事。

cues.en: You can see all of our debugging output that illustrates what happens at each stage within our loadMovieLensLatestSmall function as we build up the outlier data and exclude ratings from these outliers.
cues.zh: 可以看到所有除錯輸出，展示 loadMovieLensLatestSmall 函式在建構離群資料、排除離群使用者評分時，各階段發生的事。

cues.en: An important takeaway is that we started off with 100,004 ratings and ended up 80,398.
cues.zh: 一個重要觀察是，一開始有 100,004 筆評分，最後剩下 80,398 筆。

cues.en: So even with a fairly conservative definition of an outlier as being beyond three standard deviations, we ended up losing quite a few ratings.
cues.zh: 所以即使採用相當保守的離群定義，也就是超過三個標準差，仍然損失了不少評分。

cues.en: The resulting hit rate was 4.4%, and we saw hit rates from this same algorithm over 5% earlier.
cues.zh: 結果命中率是 4.4%，而之前同一個演算法的命中率超過 5%。

cues.en: So it would seem that in this case, eliminating outliers did more harm than good.
cues.zh: 所以在這個例子中，排除離群值似乎弊大於利。

cues.en: That's just specific to this dataset however.
cues.zh: 不過，這只針對這個資料集。

cues.en: It turns out that the MovieLens dataset we're working with has already been filtered and cleaned, and we know all of this data represents real individual people, so by filtering
cues.zh: 原來，我們使用的 MovieLens 資料集已經過篩選與清理，而且知道所有資料都代表真實的個別使用者，所以濾除，

cues.en: out outliers, we're just filtering out valid information.
cues.zh: 離群值，就只是在濾掉有效資訊。

cues.en: But in a real world situation, things will probably be quite different, and you'll find that removing outlier users, or even outlier items, can have a measurable improvement on your results.
cues.zh: 但實務情況大概會很不一樣。你會發現，移除離群使用者，甚至離群項目，都可能讓結果獲得可衡量的改善。
